entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Yeah, finally. Listen, this is completely unacceptable. I ordered a jersey from you and it's useless. Absolutely useless.
I'm very sorry to hear that. I can certainly look into this for you. Could you please provide me with your order number?

It's VF88602. And don't give me the runaround. The jersey is the wrong size, it's way too tight. I can't even zip it up. I want to return it right now. If this isn't fixed in the next five minutes, I'm lighting you up on every review site on the planet.
I understand your frustration, and I'll do my best to resolve this quickly. One moment while I pull up order VF88602... Okay, I see your order for the Pro-Series Jersey, delivered twelve days ago.
Twelve days, a month, I don't care. It doesn't fit. Are you going to fix this or do I need to speak to your manager?

There's no need for that, I can definitely help you. I see you're well within our 90-day return policy. Since the issue is that the jersey is the wrong size, I can process an exchange for a larger size immediately. There will be no cost to you.
Wait, really? You're just going to do it? No hassle?
Of course. We want to make sure your gear fits properly. It sounds like you need to exchange that jersey because it was too tight. What size would you like to get instead?
Oh. Well, thank you. I need a Large. The Medium was just... yeah, way too tight. I couldn't believe it.

Not a problem at all. I have just processed the exchange for a size Large. You'll get an email shortly with a pre-paid return label for the Medium. Once you send that back, we'll ship the new one out.
Wow, okay. That was... a lot easier than I was expecting. Thanks, Charlie. Sorry for being a bit aggressive, it's just been a hectic holiday.
I completely understand. I'm glad I could make this easy for you. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's it. You've been a great help. Thank you.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
